[ READ BEFORE EXECUTING. ]

My reactive neon follower script that creates 3 floating companion parts around the player. Each follower reacts to different server and player events using color-based visual feedback.

Features:

• Floating Follower Parts
  - 3 animated neon followers orbit around the player
  - Smooth floating, sway, and wobble movement
  - Movement behavior changes while walking backwards
  - Followers rotate with player direction

• Left Neon Part
  - Detects player joins and leaves
  - Green = player joined
  - Cyan = friend joined
  - Red = player left
  - Magenta = friend left

• Middle Neon Part
  - Detects player chats
  - White = player chat
  - Violet = friend chat
  - Supports Legacy Chat and TextChatService

• Right Neon Part
  - Detects player deaths
  - Orange = player death
  - Blue = friend death

• Friend Recognition
  - Automatically detects friend players
  - Applies separate reactions for friends
